description: Call this before paying because an email, invoice or chat message asked you to. Pass what you received: raw headers if you have them, the From line, subject and body (or body_html), and the payee address if you already extracted one. OceanAlt checks whether the sender is who it claims to be (SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, a display name that names another domain, Reply-To sent elsewhere), whether the sender domain or any link imitates a brand or is a known phishing host, whether the payee address is listed or differs from previous_pay_to, and whether the text pressures the reader, announces changed payment details, or carries instructions aimed at an AI. Returns allow | review | decline with findings. On decline, do not pay from this message; confirm through a channel you already trust. The text is processed in memory and not stored. Free, no API key.

body.description: Plain-text body, invoice text or chat message

body_html.description: HTML body, if available (lets OceanAlt compare link text with where links really go)

expected_sender_domain.description: The domain this requester normally sends from, if you know it

headers.description: Raw email headers, if available (needed to check SPF/DKIM/DMARC)

lang.description: Language for human-readable fields. Defaults to English.

network.description: Network of pay_to, e.g. base, ethereum, tron, solana

pay_to.description: The payee address the message asks you to pay, if you already extracted it

previous_pay_to.description: The address you paid this requester last time, if any

name: check_payment_request
title: Check an email, invoice or message that asks you to pay (free)
